description: Inflammation of blood vessels that can affect the skin and sometimes internal organs.

appearance.general: Purpura, palpable purpura, ulcers, nodules, or other inflammatory lesions may occur depending on the vessels involved.

warning_signs: Skin ulcers, extensive purpura, severe pain, fever, or symptoms suggesting internal-organ involvement require prompt medical assessment.
